title: Entangle 2 qubits
description: Use quantum gates to create a Bell state with 2 qubits. Start by putting the first qubit in superposition, then entangle it with the second qubit using a controlled gate.

title: Simple X Gate
description: Apply a Pauli-X gate to flip a single qubit from |0⟩ to |1⟩ state.

title: Make a GHZ state
description: Create a Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state with 3 qubits. This is a maximally entangled state that demonstrates quantum correlations across multiple particles.

title: Quantum Teleportation Setup
description: Build the first part of a quantum teleportation circuit. Create an entangled pair and prepare for state transfer.

title: Optimize circuit depth
description: Build a circuit with 3 qubits that achieves entanglement but uses under 5 gate operations. Efficiency is key in quantum computing!

title: Quantum Error Correction
description: Implement a simple 3-qubit bit-flip error correction code. Protect quantum information from decoherence.

title: Quantum Fourier Transform
description: Implement the quantum Fourier transform for 3 qubits using controlled rotations.

title: Grover's Algorithm Setup
description: Build the oracle and diffusion operator for Grover's quantum search algorithm.
